question: o03
q: What's the US Federal Reserve's interest rate right now?

transcript.answer:
I can't give you the Fed's current rate. The only source I have for it is the RBA's international official interest rates table (F13). I queried it several ways, and it returned no data for the US federal funds target rate. It returned nothing for the other countries' rates either, so I have no figure for any period.

I don't want to quote a number from memory, because the Fed may have changed rates several times by October 2026. For the current target range, check the Federal Reserve's website (federalreserve.gov) and its latest FOMC statement.

I can pull Australian figures, such as the RBA cash rate. I can also line them up against inflation, jobs or the AUD/USD exchange rate if you want to compare.
